description: by Hayden Donaldson Fri, June 27th 2025 at 5:46 PM KEOKUK, Ia. (KHQA) — Veterans and residents from across Iowa gathered in Keokuk on Thursday to celebrate the unveiling of the “Road of Honor,” a newly revitalized stretch of South 18th Street leading to the Keokuk National Cemetery.
